setup: A mixed quantity is split into equal pieces and the count of pieces is asked.

steps.say: The mixed number is [[w]] whole units plus [[a]]/[[b]] of one more.
Dividing by a piece of size k/[[c]] multiplies by [[c]]/k, so the count is the number of pieces that fit.
The pieces must be the same size, so the count is the number of complete pieces.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
